description.en: Cline desktop AI coding assistant: WorkOS OAuth device login, token refresh, and model discovery over the Cline catalog (free tier, Cline Pass, Cline Cloud) plus the OpenRouter passthrough list — free models are marked free in their names.
description.zh: Cline 桌面端 AI 编程助手：WorkOS OAuth 设备码登录、令牌自动续期；模型发现覆盖 Cline 自有目录（免费额度 / Cline Pass / Cline Cloud）与 OpenRouter 直通列表，免费模型在名称里标注「(免费)」。

description.en: Log in with your Cline account via WorkOS device authentication.
description.zh: 通过 WorkOS 设备代码授权登录你的 Cline 账号。
